reviewMethod: Human semantic review of all 18 frozen current-generation body figures using the read-only evidence artifact: exact DOI/page/article/source bindings, original labels/captions, byte SHA256, dimensions/type, duplicate risk and rendered image content were checked. Two PNGs and sixteen SVGs were individually inspected; partial capture reports were treated only as incomplete acquisition evidence and did not authorize unreviewed/missing figures.
quality: All approved files are readable and semantically consistent with their owning article; no TOC substitution, recommendation image, cross-DOI content, or same-byte duplicate was observed.
